package.name: uavnav_px4_bridge
package.description: PX4 bridge core for uav-navigation: FLU to FRD frame conversion, the external-vision (EV) encoder, SITL PX4 time conversion and the alignment estimator T_px4<-lio. The core library is ROS-free; the px4_bridge ROS node (message conversion, one callback group, recorder, ordered shutdown) is a second target.
